status: Primary-source research. Supplier claims and listed prices are not project approval or delivered quotes.

sources.title: CPSC warning: sealed water-walking balls
sources.evidence: 2011 warning concerns airtight zipped balls, inadequate air supply and lack of emergency egress. Do not substitute this product type for an occupied installation. This source does not evaluate every double-wall land zorb.

sources.title: H²OGO ZORB Balls
sources.evidence: Manufacturer describes its own double-zipper commercial rolling product and weight above 100 kg. No public selling price or approval for this stationary/suspended art use was located on the page. Do not transfer specifications to an unidentified sphere.

sources.title: ZORB inventors and site consultation
sources.evidence: Original manufacturer provides product and site consultation. Its rolling-site experience does not establish a top lifting point or occupied art-installation approval.

sources.title: Custom inflatable hanging balls
sources.evidence: Decorative sealed-air spheres with integrated hanging anchors; displayed starting price $729.95, size/configuration and availability to confirm. No occupied-use claim: a hanging decoration does not solve the person-inside requirement.

sources.title: Aerial Rigging 101: static setups and complete load paths
sources.evidence: Static does not remove loading requirements. Forces, supporting structure and working-load limits of all components require consideration. General guidance, not a design standard or site-specific calculation.

sources.title: Prodigy R29 aerial yoga rig
sources.evidence: Displayed $799, zero stock at read time, 2.9 m height, dry-day outdoor practice limitations. A nominal 3 m sphere does not fit below a 2.9 m attachment before adding rigging or clearance. Not a quoted installation solution.

sources.title: Mild steel square tube, cut to size
sources.evidence: Supplier offers cut-to-size material for fabrication. No project material list or fabrication quote has been obtained; stock material alone does not price a finished occupied installation.

sources.title: Love Burn art application entry
sources.evidence: Official application entry. The fetched public page did not independently establish Andrew's quoted $600–$3,000 Seed Grant tier. Keep the range user-supplied pending the actual application terms.

sources.title: Can I rig aerial equipment from a tree?
sources.evidence: Specialist guidance warns against assuming a tree is an appropriate human-load attachment. No Love Burn tree, landowner permission or arborist assessment is available for this project.

sources.title: Custom aerial acrylic bubble
sources.evidence: Maker lists CAD $11,999, approximately 270 lb apparatus weight and 8–10 week production, and describes engineer certification and an external supporting metal frame. This is evidence for the separate-frame principle, not a quote or approval for a TPU zorb; host rig, delivery and installed system remain separate.

sources.title: Portable aerial sphere
sources.evidence: Open metal performer apparatus, listed £1,639.99 ex-tax / £1,967.99 including UK tax; overseas shipping requires quote. Vendor offers certification. Not an enclosed inflatable sphere and not an installed outdoor rig; obtain the exact certificate and permitted use before comparison.

sources.title: Rotating vessel patent, Fig. 3 external straps
sources.evidence: Occupied inflatable vessel between supported end rings; guided adjustable external straps assist rotation. Closest public external-strap drawing found, but it does not validate a three-leg overhead basket. PDF preserved locally.

sources.title: Fishpipe external frame and soft barrel
sources.evidence: Actual soft rotating barrel associated with external straps and a metal support frame. Architectural precedent, not a $3,000 purchase proposal or transferable suspension rating.

sources.title: SPHERE performance
sources.evidence: Artist's occupied suspended-sphere performance. Public presentation does not disclose fabrication dimensions or prove the skin alone carries the performer.

sources.title: Engineering the suspended SPHERE performance
sources.evidence: Engineer's account of performer use inside, on and below a suspended sphere; structure and rigging considered through the crane hook. No public DIY basket calculation or sphere attachment specification.

sources.title: TreePod Lounger/Cabana instructions
sources.evidence: Product-specific fabric pod and segmented-ring assembly; use limits include no standing/jumping/swinging and a low hanging height. Does not rate a zorb or improvised fabric basket. PDF preserved locally.

sources.title: TreePod adjustable stand instructions
sources.evidence: Manufacturer stand assembly reference, not approval for the proposed 3 m sphere or a modified donor. PDF preserved locally.

sources.title: Cocoon Tree habitable sphere
sources.evidence: Metal structure, membrane and floor with suspension and lateral stabilization; ground-leg option. Useful separation of enclosure and occupant support; not a squishy inflatable or budget purchase recommendation.

sources.title: Denver steel drops sold by weight
sources.evidence: Supplier documents a drop/remnant area sold by the pound. No actual stock, price per pound, project quote or free donor confirmed.

sources.title: Denhac TIG fabrication resource
sources.evidence: Shop documents its TIG welder and authorization requirements. Andrew separately confirms denhac access and in-kind fabrication; no booking, stock or Todd availability inferred.

sources.title: Six-foot trampoline frame manual
sources.evidence: Six frame tubes and separate leg supports in a ground-use child trampoline. Illustrates donor joints and a different original load path, not the identity or rating of Andrew's prospective ring. PDF preserved locally.

sources.title: SWIVEL OPEN technical notice
sources.evidence: Distinguishes maximum working load from breaking strength and requires compatible connections. A comparison only; no swivel has been selected for this basket. PDF preserved locally.

sources.title: Synthetic lifting-sling directions
sources.evidence: Sling-angle, unequal loading and contact/edge protection guidance for the manufacturer's lifting products. Useful force-path context, not an occupied-art approval or specification.

sources.title: X-POLE A-Frame height and footprint chart
sources.evidence: 2024 manufacturer chart: maximum 3480 mm to the top of the bar, not a guaranteed usable hook height. Too short for the present 3 m sphere study's collector/swivel stack. This illustrates why a small aerial rig cannot be assumed suitable; the model's larger rig is generic and unpriced.
